parts.text:
During the collision, the average force exerted on Y by Z is $F_Y$ and the average force exerted on Z by Y is $F_Z$.

Compare the magnitudes and directions of $F_Y$ and $F_Z$. Numerical values are not required.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Two blocks, A and B, move directly towards each other along a horizontal frictionless surface, as shown in the view from above in Fig. 4.3.

{{figure:figure_4_3}}

The blocks collide perfectly elastically. Before the collision, block A has a speed of $4\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and block B has a speed of $6\text{ m s}^{-1}$. After the collision, block B moves back along its original path with a speed of $2\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

Calculate the speed of block A after the collision.
